name: Benjamin Franklin Thompson

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Mary Howard, daughter of Rev. Zachariah and Mrs Abigail Greene; son Henry Rutgers (1813-1842).

bioAdditions: Son of Dr. Samuel Thompson and his first wife Phebe Satterly (S1); 3rd cousin 8 times removed via John Thompson. Irony worth telling: his own family account (the source used by earlier rounds) contains the two errors later disproved, the 1609 birth and the Mayflower Brewster wife for John Thompson.

sources.citation: B. F. Thompson, History of Long Island, 3rd ed. (1918), vol. 3 (archive.org full text), pp. 297-298
sources.supports: Dr. Samuel Thompson's family; B. F. Thompson's birth and marriage
